items.title: Storm-2603 Hackers Exploit SharePoint ToolShell Flaws to Hide Fileless Backdoor and Launch Ransomware Attack
items.description:
A China-linked threat group tracked as Storm-2603 has used the SharePoint ToolShell flaws to plant a backdoor that never touches the disk. The group then tried to run Warlock ransomware on the same network. The break-in hit an on-premises SharePoint server and ended with a ransomware launch that security software blocked. ToolShell is the name […]
 The post  Storm-2603 Hackers Exploit SharePoint ToolShell Flaws to Hide Fileless Backdoor and Launch Ransomware Attack  appeared first on <a href="https://cybersecuritynews

items.title: Claude Dispatch Flaw Lets Malicious Browser Extensions Run Code on Connected Computers
items.description:
A flaw in Anthropic’s Claude Dispatch let a malicious browser extension run commands on a computer via Claude Desktop. That computer could even be a different machine signed into the same Claude account. Researcher Gal Weizman of Forever Security named the technique ThisBash and published the findings on November 4, 2026. Anthropic plans to retire […]
 The post  Claude Dispatch Flaw Lets Malicious Browser Extensions Run Code on Connected Computers  appeared first on <a href="https://cybersecuritynews.

items.description:
